display_name: 连续缺口源 IQ 先验训练
description: 对 32768 条合法源 clean IQ 随机遮挡连续 32 点训练从零初始化的波形先验，在固定源 pilot 比较插值；不做目标推理。
authorization: User authorizes ongoing Phase1 F-free restoration research, source-only diagnostics and GPU use.

code.environment: N607 physical GPU7 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, batch64, FP32 TF32 off

data.representation: 32768 clean source fit records and 672 fixed source pilot clean records
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 32768 fixed sampled eligible source IDs exclude RX4/6/8 day3 and pilot; 672 pilot IDs RX4/6 and RX8 grouped using scene metadata

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored 672 source pilot; not an independent blind test
data.leo_config_ref: No simulated channel added to clean IQ for this source-only prior

permissions.claim_scope: Source clean masked reconstruction only; no deployable restoration or identity accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: Prior initialized from scratch; fixed DURA only for real-checkpoint source smoke
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA original source-only provenance previously verified; no checkpoint used to initialize prior
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed original DURA source-only provenance previously verified
checkpoint.selection_rule: Final fifth epoch fixed before pilot readout

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7, at most one this-task worker, at most three total compute apps, at least 4096 MiB free; preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, nonfinite output or loss, target/F/TX access or technical failure; do not change other jobs

dimensions: fixed source pilot RX4/6 and RX8, each seven metadata groups, 48 each
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: none; no target or TX truth

rows.method: From-scratch dilated convolution, random interior 32-sample masks, mask-only normalized IQ reconstruction
rows.purpose: Test whether source-learned structure predicts withheld clean IQ beyond simple interpolation, prior to designing a recovery network
rows.seed_notes: Five epochs, fixed final epoch; source pilot mask seed independent
rows.scenario: clean source IQ only; scene labels are metadata for grouping, not satellite test
rows.budget_ref: 32768 source records x 5 epochs batch64; fixed 672 source pilot; eight-record original DURA checkpoint smoke

notes: No F weights/outputs, TX labels, V, or target IQ/truth.
No model chosen using pilot performance; final epoch fixed.
Pilot already explored and only clean IQ; grouped scene metadata do not represent impaired waveforms.
The model is not a deployed recovery network; any proposed new recovery version must receive the full mandatory seven-view test.
